lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately five horizontal rows of high-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in a grid-like pattern posterior to the gill slits.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersecting the horizontal rows of spots at regular intervals, forming a checkerboard-like structure.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Linear feature characterized by a high-intensity highlight on the superior edge and a dark shadow on the inferior edge, running longitudinally along the upper third of the visible flank.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Non-uniform distribution of low-to-medium diameter high-luminance blobs across the visible surface of the first dorsal fin silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: High-density clustering of reduced-diameter spots on the dorsal cranial region transitioning to larger, sparser spots on the trunk.
